ex_fwd.desc: PEPTIDEK against PEPGTIDEK: residues matched forward only (DeepNovo, InstaNovo 1.x)

ex_best.desc: PEPTIDEK against PEPGTIDEK: residues matched with Casanovo's prefix-then-suffix rule

ex_inv_10.desc: GGPEPTIDE against NPEPTIDE: residues matched by InstaNovo 1.0 and later

ex_inv_01.desc: GGPEPTIDE against NPEPTIDE: residues matched by InstaNovo 0.1.x

ex_pep_prec.desc: 100 labelled spectra, 80 predicted, 60 right: peptide precision, TP / (TP + FP)

ex_pep_rec.desc: The same spectra: peptide recall, TP / (TP + FN), which Casanovo prints as pep_precision

ex_swap_prec.desc: Truth PEPTIDEK, prediction PEPTIDE: amino-acid precision, correctly computed

ex_swap_rec.desc: Truth PEPTIDEK, prediction PEPTIDE: amino-acid recall, which swapped code prints as precision

d_kq.desc: Mass difference between K and Q, in Da

d_fm.desc: Mass difference between F and oxidised M, in Da

d_nd.desc: Mass difference between deamidated N and D, in Da

ppm_kq.desc: K against Q in ppm of K's mass (ProteoBench allows 20 ppm per residue)

ex_kq_pep.desc: Truth PEPTIDEK, prediction PEPTIDEQ: does the 0.1 / 0.5 Da rule count the peptide correct? (1 = yes)

ex_auc_half_nb.desc: NovoBench's AUC for 1,000 spectra, half right and all of those ranked first

ex_auc_half_cov.desc: Area under precision against coverage for the same 1,000 spectra (trapezoid, coverage = rank / N)

pmd_gg_n.desc: RankNovo PMD between GG and N, which have the same total mass (units of 51.4238 Da)

pmd_kq.desc: RankNovo PMD between PEPTIDEK and PEPTIDEQ (units of 51.4238 Da)

pmd_del.desc: RankNovo PMD for a missing residue, whatever its mass (units of 51.4238 Da)

rmd_gg_last.desc: RankNovo RMD at the last residue of PEPGGK against PEPNK, in Da (0: the masses have realigned)

rmd_gg_mid.desc: RankNovo RMD at the first G of PEPGGK against PEPNK, in Da
